response.sql: WITH large_orders AS (SELECT account_id, amount FROM `order` WHERE amount >= 2802), joined_orders AS (SELECT lo.account_id, d.A3 as region, lo.amount FROM large_orders lo INNER JOIN account a ON lo.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id), group_averages AS (SELECT account_id, region, AVG(amount) as group_avg FROM joined_orders GROUP BY account_id, region), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_average FROM group_averages), differences AS (SELECT ga.account_id, ga.region, ga.group_avg, ga.group_avg - oa.overall_average as difference FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa) SELECT account_id, region, group_avg, difference FROM differences ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
